item.title: Wake Up, Samurai! Cyberpunk 2077 Is Getting A Live-Action Movie

description.p: But who will play Johnny Silverhand?Cyberpunk 2077 didn't get off to the best start when it originally launched in 2020, but it's now considered a success story. Since then, CD Projekt Red has polished it up, rolled out an animated Netflix series, and released a Switch 2 version of the title.A second game is also in development, and now, to add to all of this, a live-action movie set in the "Cyberpunk 2077" video game universe is in the works.
